claims.claim_ar: استعمال إنَّ للتوكيد في جملة الخبر (إنَّ رحمةَ اللهِ قريبٌ)، أي توكيد المعنى وتثبيته.
claims.claim_en: Use of 'إِنَّ' for emphasis (enunciative particle) in the clause 'إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ', reinforcing and certifying the statement.

claims.claim_ar: طباق/تقاطب بين «خوفًا» و«طمعًا» (عرض حالتين متعاكستين: الخوف مقابل الطمع)، مع الربط بحرف العطف.
claims.claim_en: Antithesis (tibaq) between 'khawfan' (fear) and 'tama'an' (hope), juxtaposing opposite motives and joined by the coordinating waw.
claims.needs_review_reason: Source quote documents coordination ('الواو عاطفة') but does not explicitly name or discuss the antithetical relation; further classical rhetorical citation would strengthen the claim.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Balances hope and fear to motivate worship and reliance on God; creates moral tension and incentive.

claims.source_quote_ar: حق المعطوف أن يكون غير المعطوف عليه
claims.claim_ar: مقابلة بين النهي «ولا تفسدوا» والتوجيه العملي «وادعوه»، أي وضع نهي وتحته أمر موجّه يُظهر التباين بين الفعل المنهي والفعل المرغوب.
claims.claim_en: Contrast (muqabalah) between the prohibition 'Do not corrupt' and the positive injunction 'call upon Him', presenting a negative/positive structural opposition.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited chunk discusses properties of coordination and the possibility of a pause between conjuncts; it supports noting a structural difference but does not explicitly label this instance as 'مقابلة' in the classical source.

warnings: Provided source chunks are primarily i'rab and tafsir excerpts (Darwish, Zamakhshari); explicit classical rhetorical statements by al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, or al-Suyuti are not present in the supplied chunks. Some claims are therefore supported indirectly (coordination/pausal commentary) rather than by explicit classical rhetorical labels.

Some device identifications (e.g., 'طباق' for خوفًا وطمَعًا, 'مقابلة' between prohibition and injunction) are typical rhetorical readings; the supplied quotes document coordination or related grammatical points but do not always name the rhetorical device directly — such claims are marked with medium confidence and include reasons for review.
